{{Quote|You have something I want. I intend to take it. Give it to me now and we'll let you go.|Adrick|<ref name="Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
'''Adrick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Ground Forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
===Search for the Jedi holocron===
{{Quote|The speeder went down near here. Find it!|Adrick|<ref name="Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)" />}}
[[File:Adrick.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Adrick commanding Imperial troops]]
Holding the rank of a [[Captain/Legends|captain]], Adrick was involved in a large operation with a purpose to obtain the [[Codex of Tython]], an ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] discovered by the agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The agent's [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] crashed in a remote area of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and Adrick and his troopers were sent out to capture him. They were able to find the crash site and discovered a cache of Jedi relics hidden nearby, but it was already empty. After a day's search, the Imperials were able to located the Rebel agent, who was carrying the Codex. A group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] surrounded the Rebel and Adrick demanded the relic from the Rebel, promising to let him go. The Rebel refused and Adrick simply ordered his troops to kill him and take the relic. However, in the ensuing firefight the Rebel received aid from the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Drakka Judarrl]], who created an illusion, which distracted the Imperials and allowed the Rebel to escape into the night.<ref name="COTF">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

Adrick continued to follow the Rebel, who managed to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and headed for [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, Adrick dispatched another squad to ambush him and capture the Codex, but the troopers were all slaughtered by a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Mellichae]] and his minions. Adrick returned to the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']] to report to the [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Andal Sait]] on his progress. Sait wanted the Codex looking for the plans of new weapons, but Adrick developed his own agenda. Understanding the value of the Jedi relics, he stole a fragment of the holocron, which belonged to Andal Sait himself. However, this fragment was in turn taken from him, when the Rebel agent infiltrated the ''Blackguard'' and ambushed Adrick, which allowed him to complete and finally activate the Codex.<ref name="COTF" />

===Mission to Hoth===
{{Quote|The Nightsister must be in that outpost! Find her and take her alive!|Adrick|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] a small Rebel outpost was discovered on a remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agents looking for an exiled [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]]. Adrick, now holding the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], was leading the group sent by [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] to reinforce the Imperial presence on the planet and wipe out the outpost. He led a strike force consisting of one [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]], two [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|AT-PTs]] and a squad of [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] to the outpost, mistakenly believing that the Nightsister [[Kyrisa]] was in there and hoping to capture her. However, their approach was spotted by Rebel scouts, which gave the Rebels time to mount a defense. Adrick ordered his troopers to [[Battle of Hoth (2 ABY)|attack]] the outpost, but the initial assault was met with heavy blaster fire, forcing them to fall back. Then, the AT-ST arrived at the battlefield and provided cover for the snowtroopers by blazing away at Rebel positions. Eventually, the Alliance managed to severely damage the walkers, but the snowtroopers were still putting up a good fight regardless. The battle ended when a blizzard began, engulfing both armies and making it impossible for them to continue. After the storm the Rebels examined the battlefield and found several Imperial bodies and discovered that one of the light AT-PTs was missing, but no signs of the Imperials were found in the nearby area.<ref name="TNR">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Adrick was created for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'', where he serves as one of the recurring antagonists in the Light Side scenario campaigns.

While the campaign of ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'', told from the Rebel point of view, suggests that all Imperials on Hoth were either killed in the battle or perished in a snowstorm, [[Chuck Kallenbach]], one of the game's designers, teased the players with the possibility that Adrick might have survived.<ref name="Q+A">{{SonyForumsCite|url=strategygames/posts/list.m?topic_id=24090|text=Q+A Answers for 12/4 - 12/17/2009}}</ref>
